facts.fact: Raxio Data Centre announced that Liquid Intelligent Technologies' Microsoft Azure Stack is operational in its Ugandan facility, which offers colocation space for up to 400 racks to customers; article dated 21 August 2024.
Raxio Data Centre's general manager states its Ugandan facility is certified to Tier III standards (operator statement, no certifier named).
